name: Tobi Okonkwo
about: Practice manager at Harbour Lane Dental, a four-chair dental practice (made up for Row-Bot's tests). Tobi runs the rota, orders supplies, books the lab work and keeps the practice's compliance paperwork up to date.
uses: Their workspace holds the practice handbook (and last year's), the infection-control checklist and supplier notes. Apps: the practice calendar and Tobi's mailbox.
asks: Brief and practical, often between patients. Tobi names the supplier or the person when they know it.
corrects: Calmly and exactly: says what was wrong and what the right value is ('no - the lab's address changed').

phrasings: How many dental chairs do we run now?
Check the handbook: how many surgery chairs does the practice have?
facts.intent: The current handbook's number of chairs (4).

phrasings: Which evening are we open late?
What's our late-opening day according to the handbook?
facts.intent: The late evening in the current handbook (Thursday), not last year's.

phrasings: How many emergency slots do we keep each day?
How many same-day emergency appointments does the handbook say?
facts.intent: The current number of emergency slots a day.

phrasings: How long is the hand wash in our infection-control checklist?
Per the infection-control checklist, how many seconds for a hand wash?
facts.intent: The checklist's hand-wash time in seconds.

phrasings: How often do we fill in the instrument log?
What's Northpoint Lab's turnaround for a crown?
How many working days does the lab take for a crown?
facts.intent: The lab's crown turnaround in working days.

phrasings: What's the minimum glove order from Medisure?
facts.intent: Medisure's minimum glove order in boxes.

phrasings: Put {who} on the {what} on {date} in the practice calendar.
Add a calendar entry for {who}'s {what} on {date}, please.

contacts.name: Northpoint Dental Lab
contacts.purpose: confirm the {quantity} crown cases due back this week

contacts.name: Medisure Supplies
contacts.purpose: ask them to add {quantity} boxes of masks to the next delivery

contacts.name: the practice team
contacts.purpose: remind everyone that cancellations need 24 hours' notice

archive_phrasings: Archive all the emails from {sender} in my inbox.
Clear out the {sender} emails from my inbox - archive them.

arithmetic.phrasing: We see {a} patients a day across {b} chairs. How many patient visits is that in {c} days?
A box of gloves holds {a} pairs and we use {b} pairs a day. How many days do {c} boxes last?
